name: Bee Panel

steps: Print 1 base, 2 segments, 6 net cups and 1 top cap. PETG, no supports.

Feed the tubing up through the segments into the top cap inlet, then press the cap on.
Fill the bucket with water and nutrients, keeping the level below the base.
Put seedlings in clay pebbles inside the net cups and drop one into each pocket.
Switch the pump on: water rises to the cap and trickles back down through the roots.
